answer_2.quote: Images were generated at 512x512 pixels and resized to 256x256 for evaluation using the FID-30k metric

answer_4.quote: Three raters are presented with two sets of images generated by UNIMO-G and the compared model. They are asked to compare these images from three dimensions of semantic relevance, visual faithfulness and image fidelity, and then select the model they prefer, or indifference.
answer_4.guideline: Raters compare images from UNIMO-G and the compared model and select the preferred model based on the dimensions of semantic relevance, visual faithfulness, and image fidelity.
